APPROVE
The extracted helpers (`BoundLiteral`, `IsRejectedKeyValue`, `IsLookupKeyNotKeyMaterial`, `ClassifyCryptoKey`) keep the original logic and short-circuit order exactly, and they remove the nested ternary, both boolean chains, the lookup-key `if` and the switch expression from the loop, which should bring 28 under 15. I couldn't build or measure it because the source isn't on this machine, so the build depends on `lines` being a `string[]` and `words` a `List<string>`.
